## Bio

Data Scientist and AI/ML Engineer with 3+ years building end-to-end ML systems across computer vision, NLP, generative AI, and big data — from social-impact and geospatial domains to multimodal search and LLM applications. Grounded in the full data engineering stack: Hadoop, Spark, Hive, cloud pipelines, and ETL at scale. Currently deepening work in transformer architectures, RAG systems, embedding fine-tuning, and LLM fine-tuning.

Comfortable moving between IC model work and leading cross-functional teams (up to 65 contributors). Treats MLOps, reproducibility, versioning, and pipeline hygiene as core engineering, not an afterthought. Away from the keyboard: cricket, hockey, MMA, the NFL, and movies.
